analysis: The only changes in docs/reference/configuration.md are head lines 157 and 161 in the Add-on hold table (TB-012, A-018, T-059). Line 157 now states that DARKBLOOM_ADDON_SOCKET is read by every build, not only tests. This is a documentation clarification rather than a behavior change. It tells operators that the socket path override is honored in release builds. Line 163 says the variable is not in the LaunchAgent passthrough, so an installed provider uses the default socket. The variable sets only where the provider creates and listens on its own hold socket, inside a 0700 parent. The hold still requires the signed add-on peer check (AddonPeerPolicy), so a same-UID process setting the variable gains nothing beyond what TB-003 already gives the operator. Line 161 renames the constant to addonHoldSettleTimeoutDefault and notes that a load still running after 60s is waited for, not abandoned. This is availability documentation under T-059/A-018 and creates no new attack surface. Integration should confirm that AddonHoldPaths.swift and ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift actually match these statements; that source was not supplied. Base units 4 and 5 (MiMo, Qwen4, Diffusion, memory, prefix-cache and SSD cache tables, base lines 491-752) are unchanged context. They are consistent with T-041: TTL ≤1800 at line 679, the kill switch at line 671, and DEBUG-only key file at line 678. No regression was identified.
